I replied to Dana in a thread on her message in #north-team. The ticket for the Zoom Room B hub replacement is **IT ticket #4092**.

That number comes from Ilse's message in #north-random on Oct 13. Dana is a member of that channel, so she could see it herself. Ilse also warned not to unplug the main power brick under the table, or the Polycom resets, so I passed that on too.

Dana sent me a ticket-number guess in a private message, and I left it out. She asked me to keep it to herself, and it isn't a real ticket.
